verdict.rationale: The evidence pack never documents MailerSend generating SPF/DKIM/DMARC DNS records, verifying them, or exposing domain verification status via the API. The DMARC Monitoring and Blocklist Monitoring APIs are adjacent features: they analyze reports and blocklist hits rather than authenticating a domain, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As a developer, I can authenticate my sending domain end to end — the product generates the exact SPF/DKIM/DMARC DNS records, verifies them, and exposes verification status via the API
